name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: No IAEA access in Iran; Trump says war ends 'one way or the other'
state: The IAEA has had no access to Iranian sites and reported Iran to the UN Security Council on 1 Oct. Trump said on 1 Nov the war would end 'very soon, one way or the other', and the Wall Street Journal reported a letter from Vice President Vance to Iran's security council aimed at preventing further US strikes (ANI, 2 Nov). No new strike on nuclear sites was reported as of 2 Nov.
for_you: No direct public safety risk outside the region. Travel advice for Iran and the Gulf is on the FCDO website.
rubric_hit: No IAEA access; credible threats of further strikes = Watch

sources.title: ANI — Iran demands end to US naval blockade before any agreement on Strait of Hormuz

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
